title: Rename a misspelled export and keep a deprecated alias
issue:
Typo in the public API: `parseDurration`

The main export is spelled `parseDurration` (two r's). Every new user trips over it, and autocomplete in my editor never finds it when I type `parseDuration`.

Could we rename it to `parseDuration` everywhere (source, README, tests)? Lots of projects already import the misspelled name, though, so please keep `parseDurration` working as an alias for now and mark it `@deprecated` so editors show it struck through. We'll remove it in 2.0.

checks.name: old and new imports, CLI, deprecation
